basic_info.description: Welcome to this tastefully refined Outer Parkside home where no expense was spared using luxury finishes such as Buster & Punch hardware, rich oak floors, and newer windows with transferable lifetime guarantee. Upon entry, hang your coat in the thoughtfully planned mudroom before heading up the stairs to the front-facing light-filled living room and gourmet kitchen featuring high-end appliances like Miele and an eat-in dining area. Two rear-facing quiet bedrooms with closet systems and remodeled bathroom showcasing brass accents, heated washlet, and designer tile complete this level. Downstairs the bonus 3rd bedroom lined with custom cabinetry serves as a primary ensuite, home office, den, or creative space. Also included on the lower level - a detailed laundry room and modern magazine-worthy bathroom both boasting Carrera marble accents. The one-car garage offering endless storage leads out to a private drip system landscaped backyard. Enjoy the best of Ocean Beach living with easy access to vibrant cafes and restaurants such as Andytown and Galinette on Taraval or Java Beach Cafe by the Zoo. Explore nearby coastal trails or catch the sunset walking along the Great Highway. Convenient access to Muni lines, Sunset Blvd, and Sloat ensures a seamless commute.
